audit_items.proof_trace: TOCTOU race condition: SidecarParentValid check (L120) reads badBlockCache while parent block validation runs concurrently in ReceiveBlock. Parent can fail validation and be marked bad AFTER the sidecar passes the check but BEFORE acceptance (L226), violating the invariant that accepted sidecars must have valid parents.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker sends invalid block B, then immediately sends its data column sidecar S via P2P gossip. While B is processing asynchronously (validateBeaconBlockPubSub → ReceiveBlock → validateExecutionAndConsensus), S reaches SidecarParentValid check before B is marked bad. S passes validation and gets accepted despite B being invalid.
